verses.en: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.
verses.pt: Grande é o Senhor e mui digno de ser louvado, na cidade do nosso Deus, no seu monte santo.
verses.en_web: Great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised, in the town of our God, in his holy mountain.

verses.en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, is mount Zion, on the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
verses.pt: De bela e alta situação, alegria de toda terra é o monte Sião aos lados do norte, a cidade do grande Rei.
verses.en_web: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.
verses.en_bbe: Beautiful in its high position, the joy of all the earth, is the mountain of Zion, the mountain of God, the town of the great King.

verses.en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
verses.pt: Nos palácios dela Deus se fez conhecer como alto refúgio.
verses.en_web: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.
verses.en_bbe: In its buildings God is seen to be a high tower.

verses.en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
verses.pt: Pois eis que os reis conspiraram; juntos vieram chegando.
verses.en_web: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.
verses.en_bbe: For see! the kings came together by agreement, they were joined together.

verses.en: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.
verses.pt: Viram-na, e então ficaram maravilhados; ficaram assombrados e se apressaram em fugir.
verses.en_web: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.
verses.en_bbe: They saw it, and so were full of wonder; they were troubled, and went quickly away in fear.

verses.en: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.pt: Aí se apoderou deles o tremor, sentiram dores como as de uma parturiente.
verses.en_web: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.
verses.en_bbe: Shaking came on them and pain, as on a woman in childbirth.

verses.en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
verses.pt: Com um vento oriental quebraste as naus de Társis.
verses.en_web: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.en_bbe: By you the ships of Tarshish are broken as by an east wind.

verses.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
verses.pt: Como temos ouvido, assim vimos na cidade do Senhor dos exércitos, na cidade do nosso Deus; Deus a estabelece para sempre.
verses.en_web: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of Yahweh of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: As it came to our ears so have we seen it, in the town of the Lord of armies, in the town of our God; God will keep it fixed for ever. (Selah.)

verses.en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
verses.pt: Temos meditado, ó Deus, na tua benignidade no meio do teu templo.
verses.en_web: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.
verses.en_bbe: Our thoughts were of your mercy, O God, while we were in your Temple.

verses.en: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.pt: Como é o teu nome, ó Deus, assim é o teu louvor até os confins da terra; de retidão está cheia a tua destra.
verses.en_web: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: As your name is, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.

verses.en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
verses.pt: Alegre-se o monte Sião, regozijem-se as filhas de Judá, por causa dos teus juízos.
verses.en_web: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.
verses.en_bbe: Let there be joy in the mountain of Zion, and let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of your wise decisions.

verses.en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
verses.pt: Dai voltas a Sião, ide ao redor dela; contai as suas torres.
verses.en_web: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.
verses.en_bbe: Make your way about Zion, and go round it, numbering its towers.

verses.en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell it to the generation following.
verses.pt: Notai bem os seus antemuros, percorrei os seus palácios, para que tudo narreis à geração seguinte.
verses.en_web: Mark well her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.
verses.en_bbe: Take note of its strong walls, looking well at its fair buildings; so that you may give word of it to the generation which comes after.

verses.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.
verses.pt: Porque este Deus é o nosso Deus para todo o sempre; ele será nosso guia até a morte.
verses.en_web: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.
verses.en_bbe: Because this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide.
